name: Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Typing
original_name: ときめきメモリアルGirl's Sideタイピング
source:
Believing that one day a prince will come for you…
Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side is now a typing game. Polish your skills with four mini typing games, and set out on dates with the character you admire. Keep the conversation lively and make lots of memories.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/contents/index.html]official website[/url]]
